scope: Selected Formal plan -> FIRST BUY signal opportunity; signal is not broker fill.
structuralFindings: Formal freshness is an independent downstream gate: analyzeStockSmart replaces an otherwise computed buy decision with wait/watch unless quoteFresh and formal15Fresh are true.
Plan validity is applied after buildFinalDecision: wrong planDate suppresses new position/add; trial quote converts buy to watch.
evaluateOperationSignals applies maxChase again using currentPrice even after finalDecision=buy, so a candle-confirmed BUY can still produce no BUY signal if current quote exceeds maxChase.
For B, evaluateMomentum also checks latest 15m close against maxChase before breakout/retest logic; this is distinct from operation-layer currentPrice maxChase.
For A, evaluatePullback has no internal maxChase check, but operation-layer currentPrice maxChase still applies.

A plan can be SELECTED yet structurally unable to BUY early in session because current previous-five-bar volumeRatio construction makes earliest theoretical A/B 15m BUY about 10:45; existing EA-022/023 owns this finding.
Persisted BUY is positive evidence of a Formal signal, not actual fill.

doubleGateImportant.B: 15m close maxChase inside evaluateMomentum plus current quote maxChase inside evaluateOperationSignals.
doubleGateImportant.A: current quote maxChase only at operation layer for BUY emission.
doubleGateImportant.interpretation: Do not aggregate MAX_CHASE_NO_BUY without identifying which layer blocked it.

completenessGuard: Missing BUY row alone is never NO_BUY.
NO_BUY classification requires exact plan/date monitor-recorder completeness.
Current rolling newest-first LIMIT 500/recent 80 evidence cannot prove historical exact-date absence.
FORMAL_SIGNAL_OBSERVED batch scope can be ambiguous; symbol-specific BUY needs same-symbol evidence.
Actual fill remains UNKNOWN without broker/order lifecycle evidence.
biasControls: selection/trigger survivorship: retain every selected plan denominator
look-ahead: classify causes only from contemporaneous observed states
data snooping: no threshold/window tuning from winners
market-source bias: freshness/mechanism UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN
date clustering: scanDate is independent inference unit
transaction costs/slippage and odd-lot mechanism required before economic promotion
zero-pick and idle-capital effects reported separately
factor redundancy: this is lifecycle accounting, not a new alpha factor

optimizationBridge.rule: Only a specific cause may become a future candidate after complete-coverage prospective evidence shows persistent missed-upside net of avoidance benefit, costs, regime/channel/liquidity controls and UNKNOWN coverage. Universal BUY relaxation is not supported.
